build_predibase_config: build a PredibaseConfig instance with adapter_id, temperature, and max_new_tokens for inference calls
map_openai_params_to_predibase: map OpenAI chat completion params like temperature, max_tokens, and n to Predibase-compatible optional params
validate_predibase_environment: validate the Predibase environment by checking for an API key and returning configured HTTP headers
get_predibase_error_class: get the PredibaseError exception class for a given HTTP status code and error message
get_supported_openai_params: get the list of supported OpenAI params for a Predibase model such as stream, temperature, and max_tokens
